steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_1De: Input your Fortnite mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse Sensitivity. Include your targeting and scope sensitivities for a complete conversion.
steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game to convert to. Fortnite's third-person perspective and building mechanics make the aiming feel different from first-person shooters.
steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_3De: Apply the converted sensitivity. Building and editing sensitivity may need separate adjustment — focus on aim feel first.
